records.jp: （あ……圭と有理が話してる。<CR>珍しいな、何を話してるんだろう？）
records.en_original: (Ah... Kei and Yuri are talking to each other. That's unusual; I wonder what they're talking about...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh, Kei and Yuri are talking to each other. That's unusual. I wonder what they're talking about.)
records.en: (Ah... Kei and Yuri are talking to each other.<CR>That's unusual; I wonder what they're talking about...)

records.jp: 制服というものは自らの所属を示すものだろう？<CR>冬服であろうと、この高校の所属だとわかれば問題はないはずだ
records.en_original: A uniform identifies you as part of a group.  The winter uniform demonstrates my ties to the school as well as any.
records.en_auxiliary: A uniform identifies you as part of a group. The winter uniform clearly demonstrates my ties to the school as well as any other uniform.
records.en: A uniform identifies the group to which one belongs, correct?<CR>As long as this winter uniform identifies me as a student of this school, there should be no problem.

records.jp: いやいや、でもその格好は暑いでしょ？<CR>冬ならわかるんだけどさ
records.en_original: But aren't you hot wearing that? I'd understand if it was still cold out, but...
records.en_auxiliary: But aren't you hot wearing that? I'd understand if it was still cold out, but...
records.en: But aren't you hot wearing that? I'd understand if it was still cold out,<CR>but...

records.jp: 素肌を日光にさらすよりも、袖で覆う方が結果的には涼しい。<CR>同時に、直射日光による皮膚への害も軽減することが可能だ
records.en_original: Covering up is cooler than exposing your skin to the sun. It also minimizes damage done to the skin by the sun's rays.
records.en_auxiliary: Covering up is cooler than exposing your skin to the sun. It also minimizes damage done to the skin by the sun's rays.
records.en: Covering bare skin with sleeves ultimately keeps one cooler than exposing it to sunlight.<CR>It also reduces skin damage from direct sunlight.

records.jp: 特に夏場のＵＶ－Ｂは多い上、浴びても肌に異常を起こすだけで<CR>デメリットしかない。遮断しておくのが望ましいだろう
records.en_original: UVB is especially prominent in the summer, and exposure causes negative effects. Best to block it off entirely, no?
records.en_auxiliary: UVB is especially prominent in the summer, and exposure has negative effects. Best to block it off entirely, no?
records.en: UV-B levels are especially high in summer, and exposure only causes skin damage.<CR>There are no benefits, so blocking it is preferable.

records.jp: ユー、ブイ、ビー？<CR>よくわからないけど、紫外線ってやつ？
records.en_original: UV...B? Look, you've lost me. Are we still talking about being hot?
records.en_auxiliary: UV...B? Look, you've lost me. Are we still talking about being hot?
records.en: U, V, B?<CR>I don't really understand, but you mean ultraviolet rays?

records.jp: 圭、有理。<CR>何の話をしてるの？
records.en_original: Kei, Yuri, what are you talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: Kei, Yuri, what are you talking about?
records.en: Kei, Yuri.<CR>What are you talking about?

records.jp: あ、白井……。<CR>いや、大したことじゃないんだけどさ
records.en_original: Ah, Shirai... Not much.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, Shirai! Not much.
records.en: Oh, Shirai...<CR>It's nothing important.

records.jp: 斎木がいつも冬服を着てるから、<CR>何でなのかなーって
records.en_original: I was just wondering why Saiki is always wearin' her winter uniform.
records.en_auxiliary: I was just wondering why Saiki is always wearin' her winter uniform.
records.en: Saiki always wears her winter uniform,<CR>so I was wondering why.

records.jp: むしろ夏服でなくてはならないことに<CR>説明がつかないだろう？
records.en_original: I don't see any logical advantages to wearing a summer uniform.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't see any logical advantages to wearing a summer uniform.
records.en: Rather, can you explain<CR>why it must be a summer uniform?

records.jp: うーん、そうなのかな……？
records.en_original: Hmm, I don't know...
records.en_auxiliary: You really mean that?
records.en: Hmm, I wonder...?

records.jp: あ、でも衣替えってよく言うじゃん！　６月１日とかにやるやつ！<CR>それでみんな冬服から夏服に変えるんだよ
records.en_original: It's like a fashion thing! Like no white after Labor Day, but no winter uniforms after June 1st!
records.en_auxiliary: It's like a fashion thing! Like no white after Labor Day, but no winter uniforms after June 1st!
records.en: But there's koromogae, the seasonal change of clothes! You know, on June 1!<CR>That's when everyone switches from winter to summer uniforms.

records.jp: ふむ……しかしそれは天気や気温で判断せずに、<CR>日付だけで決めているだろう？
records.en_original: Hm... But that's an arbitrary rule that has nothing to do with the climate, only a set date.
records.en_auxiliary: Hm. But that's an arbitrary rule that has nothing to do with the climate. It's only about a certain date.
records.en: Hmm... But that means the decision is based solely on the date,<CR>not on the actual weather or temperature, correct?

records.jp: 実際の寒暖がほとんど考慮されていない。<CR>非常に不合理だ
records.en_original: It's completely irrational and disregards variances in weather and temperature.
records.en_auxiliary: It's completely irrational and disregards variances in weather and temperature.
records.en: The actual heat or cold is barely considered.<CR>It is highly irrational.

records.jp: むむむ……
records.en_original: Grrr...
records.en_auxiliary: Grrr...
records.en: Grrr...

records.jp: そうだ、白井！<CR>白井からも何とか言ってやってよ！
records.en_original: Come on, Shirai, back me up here!
records.en_auxiliary: Come on, Shirai, back me up here!
records.en: I know, Shirai!<CR>You tell her too!

records.jp: え？　ええと……
records.en_original: Huh? Um...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Um...
records.en: Huh? Um...

records.jp: うーん……みんな夏服だし、<CR>揃えてみるのもいいんじゃないかな……？
records.en_original: Well... Everyone's wearing the summer uniform, so why not try to fit in?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, everyone's wearing the summer uniform, so why not try to fit in?
records.en: Hmm... Everyone else is in summer uniforms,<CR>so maybe it would be nice to match them...?

records.jp: ふむ……みんなで同じものを……<CR>いわゆる同調圧力というものか
records.en_original: Hmm... Wear the same thing as everyone...? In other words, submit to peer pressure.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. Wear the same thing as everyone? In other words, cave in to peer pressure.
records.en: Hmm... Everyone wearing the same thing...<CR>Is that what is called peer pressure?

records.jp: そ、そういうわけじゃないんだけど……
records.en_original: Th-That's not exactly what I meant...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that's not exactly what I meant.
records.en: Th-That's not exactly what I meant...

records.jp: 何ていうか、一体感？　みたいなものを感じられるかも。<CR>そういうのを知っておくのもいいんじゃないかな
records.en_original: It's more like maintaining a sense of unity? Or something like that. It could be educational.
records.en_auxiliary: It's more like maintaining a sense of unity? Or something like that. It could be educational.
records.en: It's more like a sense of unity, I guess.<CR>It might be worthwhile to learn what that feels like.

records.jp: 一体感、か……。<CR>検討してみる価値はあるのかもしれないな
records.en_original: A sense of unity... It might be worth consideration.
records.en_auxiliary: A sense of unity... It might be worth consideration.
records.en: A sense of unity...<CR>Perhaps it is worth considering.

records.jp: そうそう！　仲間みんなで同じものをつけてると、<CR>結束が強まる感じがするんだよ！
records.en_original: That's right! If everyone wears matching stuff, it strengthens our sense of unity!
records.en_auxiliary: That's right! If everyone wears matching stuff, it strengthens our sense of unity!
records.en: Exactly! When everyone in the group wears the same thing,<CR>it feels as though the bond between us grows stronger!

records.jp: 同じもの……。<CR>ならば、この指輪で十分なのではないか？
records.en_original: Matching stuff... Then shouldn't this ring suffice?
records.en_auxiliary: So it's about feeling connected. Then shouldn't this ring suffice?
records.en: The same thing...<CR>Then should this ring not be sufficient?

records.jp: あっ、そうきたか……
records.en_original: Yeahhh, I kinda forgot about that.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I kinda forgot about that.
records.en: Oh, so that's how you're going to answer...

records.jp: あはは……。でもやっぱり、冬服着てるのを見ると<CR>暑くないのかな？　とは思うけどね……
records.en_original: Ahaha... Still, it makes me sweat just looking at the winter uniform in this weather...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... Still, it makes me sweat just looking at the winter uniform in this weather.
records.en: Ahaha... Still, when I see you in your winter uniform,<CR>I can't help wondering whether you're hot...

records.jp: まあ、本人がいいなら冬服でもいいんじゃないかな？<CR>本当にダメだったら、先生も注意するだろうし……
records.en_original: Well, as long as she's happy, it should be okay. The teachers would warn her if it was really a problem...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, as long as she's happy, it should be okay. The teachers would warn her if it was really a problem.
records.en: Well, if she is fine with it, is the winter uniform not okay?<CR>If it were truly prohibited, a teacher would say something...

records.jp: 見てるとちょっと暑そうだけど、合理的に考えて<CR>判断してるわけだし、そこは有理の個性だよね
records.en_original: It makes me hot just looking at it, but if Yuri has a logical reason to wear it, it simply makes her unique.
records.en_auxiliary: It makes me hot just looking at it, but if Yuri has a logical reason to wear it, it simply makes her unique.
records.en: It looks a little hot, but you made the decision rationally,<CR>so that's part of what makes you Yuri.

records.jp: 個性……か。なるほど、<CR>着る服に対する考え方の違いも個性のうちか
records.en_original: Unique... I see, fashion differences are an aspect of individuality.
records.en_auxiliary: Unique? I see. So fashion differences are an aspect of individuality.
records.en: Part of what makes me... I see.<CR>Differences in how one thinks about clothing are also a form of individuality.

records.jp: 個性、かあ……。そうだね。斎木って頭いいわけだし、<CR>アタイには思いつかないことも含めて色々考えた結果なんだよね
records.en_original: Individuality, huh... Yeah. Saiki's really smart, and she's thought of all kinds of things that I'd never think of.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess that's true. Saiki's really smart, and she's thought of all kinds of things that I'd never think of.
records.en: Individuality, huh... Yeah. Saiki is smart,<CR>so this is the result of considering all kinds of things I would never think of.

records.jp: 色々やかましく言っちゃってごめん、斎木！<CR>アタイ、斎木のこと全然わかってなかったよ
records.en_original: Sorry for bothering you about it, Saiki! I guess I should've just let you do you.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry for bothering you about it, Saiki! I guess I should've just let you do you.
records.en: Sorry for making such a fuss, Saiki!<CR>I didn't understand you at all.

records.jp: いや……むしろ助かったよ。こうやって話したおかげで、<CR>君のような考え方もあるのだと気づけた
records.en_original: No... It was actually helpful. Now that we've talked, I've learned more about the way you think.
records.en_auxiliary: No, it was actually helpful. Now that we've talked, I've learned more about the way you think.
records.en: No... Rather, this was helpful. Talking like this made me realize<CR>that ways of thinking like yours exist too.

records.jp: そして、全て合理的に判断しようとするのが<CR>私の考え方なのだということも
records.en_original: And also that trying to make all of my decisions through logic is part of my way of thinking.
records.en_auxiliary: And also that trying to make all of my decisions through logic is part of my way of thinking.
records.en: And that trying to judge everything rationally<CR>is itself my way of thinking.

records.jp: 斎木……
records.en_original: That's really something...
records.en_auxiliary: That's good to know, I suppose.
records.en: Saiki...

records.jp: 今度、夏服にも袖を通してみるとしよう。<CR>それで何か得られることがあるかもしれないしな
records.en_original: I'll try wearing the summer uniform sometime. It might be a beneficial experience for me.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll try wearing the summer uniform sometime. It might be a beneficial experience for me.
records.en: I shall try wearing the summer uniform sometime.<CR>I may gain something from the experience.

records.jp: うん！　きっと斎木も夏服の良さに気づくよ！<CR>さっぱりしてて過ごしやすいし！
records.en_original: Yeah! I'm sure you'll learn the joys of the summer uniform is! It's super refreshing, and just plain fun to wear!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! I'm sure you'll learn the secret joys of the summer uniform! It's super refreshing, and I think it's a fun change of pace!
records.en: Yeah! I'm sure you'll discover what's good about the summer uniform too!<CR>It's light and comfortable!

records.jp: それで、その後はみんなでバスケをやろう！<CR>やっぱり冬服だと運動するには暑いし！
records.en_original: And after that, we can all play basketball! It's way too hot to exercise in our winter uniforms!
records.en_auxiliary: And we can all play basketball! It's way too hot to exercise in our winter uniforms!
records.en: And after that, let's all play basketball!<CR>The winter uniform is too hot for exercise!

records.jp: バ、バスケ？　<CR>体を必要以上に動かすのは、遠慮しておく……
records.en_original: B-Basketball? I'll refrain from moving my body any more than necessary, thank you very much...
records.en_auxiliary: B-basketball? I'll refrain from moving my body any more than necessary, thank you very much.
records.en: B-Basketball?<CR>I would rather refrain from moving my body more than necessary...

records.jp: （ふふ……冬服姿の有理もいいけど、<CR>夏服を着た有理も早く見てみたいかも）
records.en_original: (Hehe... Yuri looks good in the winter uniform, but I can't wait to see her in the summer uniform, too.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hehe. Yuri looks good in the winter uniform, but I can't wait to see her in the summer uniform, too.)
records.en: (Hehe... Yuri looks good in her winter uniform,<CR>but I might want to see her in the summer uniform soon too.)
